`r lectureLine(29)`

For the final statistics lecture of SSR, today's topic is going to be Bayesian ANOVA. We're going to repeat some of the core Bayesian concepts that we need to do inferential statistics, and then apply these to ANOVA, and then of course, I'll show you how to do a Bayesian ANOVA in JASP. We're going to start with Bayesian parameter estimation, by the example that I actually started out RMS with, our beer tasting example. We're going to focus mainly on the Bayesian ANOVA, so that's the analysis that you need to know for the exam.

Open the recording and skip to the chapter you need. The chapters come from the lecture transcript, so one may start a few seconds early or late.
